properties.name: Shift On Demand
properties.units: Atlanta city; College Park city; East Point city; Hapeville city; South Fulton city; Forest Park city
properties.note: Service area is the ATL Airport Community Improvement Districts (AACIDs), a ~15.7 sq mi district spanning portions of Fulton and Clayton counties, covering portions of the cities of Atlanta, College Park, East Point, Hapeville, South Fulton, and Forest Park - not the full extent of any of these cities. Sources: web.gachamber.com/blog/Government/ATL-Airport-Community-Improvement-Districts-(CIDs)-3120, aacids.com/airport-west-board, shift-atl.com/ondemand/. No CID-specific boundary shapefile found publicly, so the six named cities are used as an approximate proxy.
